title: Zep-like conversational memory feature shipped (Phases 0-4)
summary:
All 5 phases of the Zep/Graphiti-inspired conversational memory layer are implemented, judged, and merged to main as of 2026-06-18.

Phase 0: bench harness (LoCoMo + LME-S, our-way/search/cold/distill arms).
Phase 1: LLM distiller — bench/agent-memory/distill.py, ConversationDistiller, session → atomic facts → notes via claude -p subprocess. Validated 100% on synthetic fixtures.
Fix: maxCosine floor in lib/embed.js (best=-Infinity) + /search filter in routes/graph.js (floor=-0.5 instead of >0) — distill arm was scoring 0% due to short-note cosine floor bug.
Phase 2: entity node kind — lib/overlay.js createEntity/addEntityEdge/checkEntityContradiction; POST /entity + /entity/link routes; entity extraction inline in distill.py.
Phase 3: hybrid RRF retrieval — routes/graph.js BM25 scorer + prepareRRF/scoreRRF replacing cosine-OR-lexical fallback; entity-seeded graph expansion 1-2 hops before ranking.
Phase 4: unification — /entity/link accepts task keys; task auto-wire at creation time (label→entity name match, relation:'touches'); GET /entity/:id/context returns facts+tasks; entity_context MCP tool in lib/mcp-core.js.

**Why:** Closes the 2 MISSING and 3 PARTIAL gaps in the Graphiti capability table. Zonoid now has: distiller + entity layer + contradiction trigger + fused hybrid retrieval + conversation/execution graph unification — a strict superset of Zep/Graphiti on the conversational axis, plus the execution graph differentiator neither Zep nor Mem0 can replicate.
